disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and knowingly permitting bees or equipment to remain infected with a contagious disease after written notice from the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any beekeeper who has been notified in writing by the department that his bees or equipment are infected with a contagious disease and who willfully and knowingly permits the bees or equipment to remain in such condition shall be in violation of the Bee Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hindering, resisting, or impeding an inspector in the discharge of his duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who shall hinder, resist or impede in any way an inspector in the discharge of his duties shall be in violation of the Bee Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Managing bees in hive types not approved by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: beekeepers shall manage bees only in those types of hives approved by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering honey for sale without a current inspection certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No honey shall be offered for sale unless the beekeeper has a current inspection certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Moving or establishing an apiary closer than one and one-half miles from an existing registered commercial apiary without authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no apiary shall be moved or established closer than one and one-half miles straight airline distance from an existing registered commercial apiary, unless the apiary owner is also the owner of the apiary location

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to register the location of each commercial apiary with the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Each commercial beekeeper shall register the location of each commercial apiary under his control with the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Moving colonies or equipment into the state without a required certificate of inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No colonies or equipment shall be moved into the state, unless accompanied by a certificate of inspection signed by an authorized apiary inspector of the state from which the bees originated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Bee Act or any regulation adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who violates any provision of the Bee Act or any regulation adopted by the board pursuant thereto is guilty of a misdemeanor.

definition_quote.value: a person who owns, leases or manages bees
definition_quote.quote: "beekeeper" means a person who owns, leases or manages bees

registration_required.quote: Each commercial beekeeper shall register the location of each commercial apiary under his control with the department

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: Each commercial beekeeper shall register the location of each commercial apiary under his control with the department and shall give an accurate description of the location of each commercial apiary.

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: beekeepers shall manage bees only in those types of hives approved by the board

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Abandoned colonies and contaminated equipment shall be destroyed under the supervision of the inspector when the colony is found to be infected with a contagious disease.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: No colonies or equipment shall be moved into the state, unless accompanied by a certificate of inspection signed by an authorized apiary inspector of the state from which the bees originated.

combless_package_import_exemption.quote: This section shall not apply to the movement into the state of packaged bees or queen bees if moved into the state in mailing cages free of honey.

regulated_diseases.quote: "contagious disease" means any disease, parasite or anything adversely affecting adult bees or their brood that may be spread from one bee to another bee or from one colony to another colony

disease_reporting_required.quote: The department has full power to deal with any contagious disease of bees which, in the opinion of the department, may be prevented, controlled or eradicated

quarantine_authority.quote: The department has authority to prohibit the shipment or bringing into the state [of] colonies or equipment capable of transmitting contagious disease from any state, territory or foreign country.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: The inspector shall have access to all apiaries.

apiary_minimum_distance_rule.quote: no apiary shall be moved or established closer than one and one-half miles straight airline distance from an existing registered commercial apiary

inspection_fee_charged.quote: The board may require the beekeeper to pay an amount set by the board not to exceed fifty dollars ($50.00) for each inspection, excluding the initial annual inspection, required to certify that the colonies are apparently free of contagious disease.
